path_step: Teacher attempts to edit a file group with an invalid title
test_scenario: Verify that the system handles invalid data gracefully when editing a file group, displaying an error message and keeping the teacher on the form.
pre_condition: Teacher is logged in, has access to a course with at least one existing file group, and is on the 'Files' tab of the Course Details page.
expected_result: System displays an error message (e.g., "Invalid file group title.") and the Teacher remains on the edit file group form. The file group title is not updated.
post_condition: The file group's title remains unchanged.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Files' tab on the Course Details page.
Click the 'Edit' button next to an existing file group.
System displays a form with existing file group data.
Modify the file group title with an invalid value (e.g., containing prohibited special characters or exceeding max length).
System validates the entered data and finds it invalid.

uncovered_conditions: AF1: Invalid Data during editing file group
Validation rules beyond emptiness (e.g., special characters, length for file group title)
